name: Wynn Las Vegas and Encore
insider_take: The epitome of Vegas luxury where every detail screams opulence - from the $2.7 billion construction cost to the 140,000 fresh flowers replaced daily throughout the property.
whats_special: Wynn's Lake of Dreams features a 40-foot waterfall with holographic projections and animatronic puppets that perform nightly shows. The resort also boasts the only golf course on the Las Vegas Strip, designed by Tom Fazio with 18 holes of championship play just minutes from the casino floor.
pro_tip: Book a Tower Suite room for complimentary access to the exclusive Tower Suites pool, which offers a more intimate experience away from the main pool crowds and includes dedicated butler service.
dont_miss: The Wynn Esplanades shopping corridor features the world's only Ferrari and Maserati dealership inside a casino resort. For dining, snag a reservation at Wing Lei - the first Chinese restaurant in North America to earn a Michelin star, located right inside the hotel.
pros: Luxurious suites with floor-to-ceiling windows and exceptional Strip views
Award-winning dining including celebrity chef restaurants and fine dining options
Stunning lakefront setting with waterfalls and landscaped gardens
World-class spa and fitness facilities with premium treatments
Exclusive shopping promenade with luxury boutiques and designer brands
cons: Location at north end of Strip requires travel to other casino areas
